This is how we: Personalize features and content (such as your Facebook Feed, Instagram Feed, our features that are part of AI at Meta and Stories); Personalize the ads people see, and; Make suggestions for you (such as people you may know, groups or events that you may be interested in or topics that you may want to follow) on and off our Products.

How can you manage or delete your information and exercise your rights?: We offer you a variety of tools to view, manage, download, and delete your Threads information by visiting your Threads Settings or the settings for the account you used to sign up for Threads. You may also have other privacy rights under applicable laws. To exercise your rights, visit our Help Center, your settings for Threads and Instagram, and your device-based settings. Your Threads profile may be deleted at any time by deleting the account that you used to sign up with Threads.
